title: TranslationDictionary
description: Per-origin, per-intake mapping from the origin's own values to the domain vocabulary. Lives outside code, versioned, immutable in production — a correction ships as a new version, never an edit in place. A value absent from a mapping is the unknown case at translation time: it surfaces as 'unknown' (status) or passes through untranslated (resolution_code), and never fails the event. See domain/acl/itsm.md#o-dicionário-de-tradução.

tenant_id.description: Tenant this dictionary applies to. Two tenants on the same origin system may customize different states, so the mapping is indexed by tenant and origin, not by origin alone.

source.description: The origin this dictionary translates, e.g. 'itsm'.

intake.description: Which translated contract the mapped fields feed — incident-alert.schema.json or incident-monitor.schema.json.

dictionary_version.description: Stamped as dictionary_version into every translated line this dictionary produces.

mappings.description: Only the keys relevant to this dictionary's intake are expected to be populated — status and reported_by for alert, condition for monitor.

status.description: alert only — origin value to the domain's lifecycle enum.

condition.description: monitor only — origin value to firing/cleared.

reported_by.description: alert only — origin value to automatic/manual.

resolution_code.description: alert only — origin value translated to the domain's own vocabulary for how the incident ended, e.g. 'Sem Intervenção' to 'no_intervention'. Free-form target, unlike the other three mappings, because this list grows with what each origin's outcomes actually mean.
